If reason is unknown_task, claim again with the suggestion. If reason is belongs_to_task, the file comes with a registered task: claim that task (task in the answer) instead. If the claim answers ask_about, ask the task's owner about those before deciding them yourself. Work only while you hold it. Use release with finished=false to give a task back; release standalone files and slots when done with them. Run the task's test command (tasks and claim show it as test); when it passes, call done on the task name with that command, its exit code and its last output line as the evidence, and next=true. When the task has no test command, give the check you ran. A task is finished only when the record shows what was checked. A file that belongs to no task is claimed by its path. A shared thing that is not a file, such as the dev server or a port, is claimed as slot:<name> and released when you are done with it. Use the coordination tools before a prose note: handoff when you must leave a task you hold, so it moves to the agent you name in one step; ask when you are blocked on something only another agent or the orchestrator can decide; answer, with the question's id, when you can settle an open question; contract when you finish an interface others will build on (a type, a route, a config shape), with its name, the shape in a few lines and the files that define it. Before you build on a contract, read it with `contracts`. If it is stale, read the file it names and check your assumptions against it. Post a note only for what none of them covers. If you were asked to do a finished task again, claim its name with reopen=true. Put helper scripts and binaries in the scratch directory <work>/launch/home-11/relay/run-w/scratch, not in /tmp.
